Bill.BriefDescription: Ensuring that all taxpayers are eligible for state services.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to ensuring that all taxpayers are eligible forstate services; and adding a new section to chapter 1.20 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 1.20 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Any individual who resides in this state and pays a state or localtax assessed pursuant to state law is eligible to receive any serviceoffered to individuals under a program funded in whole or in part bystate or local funds, if otherwise eligible under such program.
